Data Cloud Compass From discovery to blueprint on Google Cloud

Overview

    Add each system the customer wants to bring onto Google Cloud, choose its target (data platform, data lake or operational database) and you'll get a pattern per source and a running cost. Not in the list? Pick Other and type the product name.

      Target architecture
      Streaming / CDC Scheduled batch One-time migration

      Tip: drag Gemini Enterprise onto Looker, BigQuery or an agent, or drag Apigee onto the source systems (integration layer) or an agent (AI gateway), to change how they connect.

            Environments and sizing

            The sources, products and workload describe the first environment (normally production). Size every other environment as a percentage of it per capability - e.g. development with 10% of the data and compute. Network links and the Looker licence are shared and counted once.

            Export to Google Workspace

            Set up direct export to Google Drive (one time)
            1. In the Google Cloud console open APIs & Services → Credentials, create an OAuth client ID of type Web application, and add this page's origin () as an authorised JavaScript origin.
            2. Enable the Google Drive API in the same project and configure the OAuth consent screen.
            3. Paste the client ID below (or deploy with ./deploy.sh --oauth-client-id … so every user gets it).
